Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at xnj: the pair (xnj, ijj) comes first; its second item is ijj, so the next pair is the one whose first item is ijj: (ijj, ijj). Its second item is ijj, but ijj never appears as a first item - so ijj is the dangling end of the chain.
ANSWER: ijj, ijj, ijj, ijj
